study_identification_part.si_4_title: Mapping Neurophysiological Subtypes of Major Depressive Disorder Using Normative Models of the Functional Connectome

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression (GPR) was used to estimate normative models of functional connectivity strength (FCS) as a function of age and sex. GPR is a Bayesian nonparametric interpolation method that yields coherent measures of predictive confidence alongside point estimates. The estimation was performed using the PCNtoolkit package. ComBat harmonization was applied to correct site effects on FCS values before normative modeling.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Then, for each brain region, we estimated a normative model of FCS as a function of age and sex by using Gaussian process regression (20) in the HCs (Figure 1A; Supplement). Gaussian process regression is a Bayesian nonparametric interpolation method that yields coherent measures of predictive confidence alongside point estimates (30).

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Functional connectivity strength (FCS) was used as the response variable. FCS was computed as the sum of the connectivity between a given brain region and all other regions, based on Pearson's correlation coefficients of resting-state fMRI time series followed by Fisher's r-to-z transformation. The analysis included 220 cerebral regions from a predefined functional parcellation (Shen atlas). Correlations above a threshold of r=0.2 were used to eliminate weak correlations arising from noise.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: First, we computed the whole-brain FCS values for each participant based on a predefined functional parcellation (29), including 220 cerebral regions that had qualified fMRI signals in all participants (Supplement).

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex were used as explanatory variables (covariates) in the normative model. The normative model estimated FCS as a function of age and sex using Gaussian process regression. The study included participants aged 11-93 years.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: For each brain region, we estimated a normative model of FCS as a function of age and sex by using Gaussian process regression (GPR).
